subject: History
examFormat: The aim of the UTME syllabus in History is to prepare candidates for the Board’s examinations and to test their achievement of the course objectives: to impart knowledge of Nigerian history from earliest times to the present; to identify the similarities and relationships among the peoples of Nigeria as they relate to national unity and integration; to appreciate Nigerian history as the basis for understanding West African and African history; to apply history to understand Nigeria’s and Africa’s relationship with the wider world; to analyse issues of modernization and development; and to relate the past to the present and plan for the future. The syllabus covers Nigeria up to 1800, 1800-1900, 1900-1960 and since independence (Part I), and Africa and the wider world since 1800 (Part II). It states no exam format.
